summary: Checked all five estimates against their cited PDF pages and the coding rules. Read the complete 593-line markdown conversion, including endnotes, references, and the correction notice; recovered and checked Table 2 directly from the PDF. All recorded numerical statistics and analysis counts are supported. The script flag for s1_creativity_textual_vs_visual_model_1a.control_mean is a false positive: PDF p. 14 (printed p. 13), endnote 6 says "0.06 SDs below the mean", which directly supports -0.06. This is a signed transcription of a simulated adjusted prediction, as the extraction notes explain. The paper's accompanying 51st-percentile statement is internally inconsistent, but that is not an extraction error. Eight coding problems concern se_basis and regression.se_type in the four regression records: the stated clustering addresses repeated refinements within each participant's single idea, so the codes should be participant and clustered_participant, respectively. The output observation unit remains correct. The reported 30-percent textual-versus-control contrast has no printed numerical uncertainty, so its not_reported code is appropriate. Other requested outcome, contrast, timing, direction, and design codes are supported. No additional eligible full-sample outcome or contrast was found in the supplied article. Completeness beyond that article remains unverified: Online Appendices A-E are not included in the 16-page PDF, there are no embedded files or matching local supplements beside it, and urllib requests to the named DOI and University of St. Gallen repository both failed with WinError 10013. No appendix result is guessed or treated as a confirmed omission.
